Name: MULTI_SOUL_BONUS_RATE_PARAM_ST
Description: Runes awarded when another player in the session is defeated: runes = value × the rune cost of the defeated player's current level (the level-up cost formula), rounded down, added to the receiving player's runes (a negative value takes runes, never below 0). The row is picked by how the receiving player joined: 0 host or no join type (only while a session condition is met; otherwise nothing is given), 1000/1100/1200 cooperator by summon sign (None/Umbasa/Berserker), 2000/2100/2200 red summon sign invader, 3000/3500/3600 invader, 4000/4100 hunter 1/2, 5000 Forest guardian, 5100 Anor guardian, 6000 arena, 7000 Yellow Monk. The column is picked the same way for the defeated player.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Host
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is the host (or has no join type). Retail: 0.04 for an invader, 0.01 for a red summon sign invader.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - White Phantom - None
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - White Phantom - Gold
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - White Phantom - Berserker
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a Berserker join type cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Black Phantom - None
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is an invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Black Phantom - Gold
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Black Phantom - Berserker
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a Berserker join type invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Black Phantom - None - Invade
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is an invader who invaded. Retail: 0.15 for the host, 0.05 for a cooperator.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Black Phantom - Gold - Invade
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) invader who invaded.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Black Phantom - Berserker - Invade
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a Berserker join type invader who invaded.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Red Hunter [1]
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a hunter (first hunter join type) summoned to hunt invaders.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Red Hunter [2]
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a hunter (second hunter join type) summoned to hunt invaders.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Forest Guardian
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a Forest guardian (area guardian join type).

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Anor Guardian
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is an Anor guardian (area guardian join type).

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Arena
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is an arena opponent. Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Rune Reward Multiplier - Yellow Monk
Fields.Description: Rune multiplier when the defeated player is a Yellow Monk phantom. Retail: 0.
